description: ANCHORAGE, AK — With Election Day just 48 days away, Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) announced current plans to participate in several more U.S. Senate debates and candidate forums across Alaska this October. Senator Sullivan has already debated Mary Peltola twice this general election: at the Alaska Oil and Gas Association U.S. Senate candidate forum in […]
